say:1:1322063001:0.text: Are these the materials for crafting the wooden horse? I don't recognize this kind of wood, but it is indeed very strong...
say:1:1322063001:0.source_cn: 这些是做木马的材料吗？这种木料我不认识，但的确很结实……

say:3:1322063003:1.text: It's called a pontail. When the stem of this plant is broken, a liquid will ooze out. It can be used as an adhesive to assemble the parts of the wooden horse.
say:3:1322063003:1.source_cn: 是蓬尾芦，这种植物茎秆折断后会流出胶状的液体，是很好的...

say:4:1322063004:1.text: Oh, that's all? You have my thanks. I have only limited knowledge of things outside the human body...
say:4:1322063004:1.source_cn: 喔，这些就够了？多亏了你们，我对人体之外的东西研究有限……

say:5:1322063005:1.text: My love, do we still need to put an animal heart in the wooden horse? I also want to find some eyeballs for paint...

say:8:1322063007:1.text: Let's try to make it before dawn. When Daimon wakes up, we can give him a surprise...
